rules.accepted_credit_types: Any combination of AMA-approved Category I or II CME; AOA-approved CME; current AMA PRA; current ABMS specialty board certificate (hours as the board considers equivalent); documented self-assessment/quality improvement activities; emeritus volunteer clinical service; Board consultant service (1 hour per 2 hours, max 20/yr)
rules.alternatives: Exempt: certified or recertified by an ABMS member board within the past 3 years; enrolled in an ACGME or RCPSC residency within the previous 3 years or currently.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CME requirement does not apply to physicians who have held a Wyoming license for less than 3 years as of the renewal date.
rules.audit_note: Signed affidavit with each annual renewal; random audit of about 10% of active licensees, documents due within 45 days; keep CME records at least 4 years.

topics.who: Licensees registered with the Board of Pharmacy to dispense a controlled substance; responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance use disorders

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs. Licenses renew every year by June 30 (grace period to Sept 30 with $100 surcharge); CME counted over the previous 3 years. Board posts rules as unofficial copies; official text on rules.wyo.gov.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Board of Medicine Rules, Chapter 3, Section 7; Chapter 1, Section 10; W.S. 33-26-202(b)(xiv)
